intro: Graduate programmes, internships and careers pages at employers in Bahrain.
employersNote: Every button opens the employer’s own careers or programme page in a new tab. Programmes open and close during the year, and many are for Bahraini nationals only, so check each page for dates and entry rules. If you’re Bahraini, Tamkeen’s National Employment Program can pay part of a new graduate’s salary for up to five years; the employer applies for it. The track tags are our guide to the kind of work, not a list of vacancies. Logos belong to their owners and are shown only to identify each organisation; DSBA Hub is not affiliated with or endorsed by any of them.

tracks.label: Data science & analytics
tracks.about: Analyst and data science teams: SQL, modelling and dashboards.

tracks.label: Business analysis
tracks.about: Work that sits between a business team and its numbers: process, requirements and reporting.

tracks.label: Consulting
tracks.about: Client projects in small teams: structure the problem, analyse it, present the answer.

tracks.label: Quantitative & risk
tracks.about: Risk, credit and modelling teams in banks, investment firms and the regulator.

tracks.label: Treasury & markets
tracks.about: Treasury desks, asset managers, brokers and the exchange.

employers.name: National Bank of Bahrain
employers.why: EVOLVE is the bank’s summer internship. THRIVE is a paid internship of 6 to 12 months in a full-time role from day one.

employers.name: Citi
employers.why: Graduate analysts join Citi’s technology hub in Bahrain to build software, with exposure to cloud and data analytics.

employers.name: Investcorp
employers.why: Ten weeks inside a global alternative investment firm with an office in Manama, working across its businesses.

employers.name: Central Bank of Bahrain
employers.why: Six months of work across the central bank’s directorates, with projects, workshops and field visits.

employers.name: PwC Middle East
employers.why: Graduate intake across Assurance, Consulting, Deals and Tax & Legal. PwC Middle East has an office in Bahrain.

employers.name: stc Bahrain
employers.why: A one-year programme with job rotations across core services, fintech, technology and support functions.

employers.name: Mumtalakat
employers.why: Bahrain’s sovereign wealth fund. Its careers page has routes for graduates and for interns who want a start in investments.

employers.name: Bapco Energies

offers.name: Information and Digital Technology Graduate Trainee Program

employers.why: A one-year programme built on on-the-job learning in the energy group’s information and digital technology teams. Empower is an eight-week summer internship matched to your major.

employers.name: SICO
employers.why: Summer interns see asset management, brokerage, treasury and research. New graduates get six months of training.

employers.name: KPMG in Bahrain
employers.why: An internship that places students in the Audit, Tax and Advisory teams of KPMG in Bahrain.

employers.name: Bahrain Bourse
employers.why: Six months of hands-on experience across the stock exchange and Bahrain Clear. Emerging Talents is its two-month graduate training.

employers.name: BENEFIT
employers.why: A summer internship at Bahrain’s payments network, with on-the-job training in data services and payment services.

employers.name: Gulf International Bank
employers.why: GIB has run a Bahrain internship for new graduates in past years (2022, 2024 and 2025). Check its job search for the next one.

employers.name: Deloitte Middle East
employers.why: Tadarab is its internship for undergraduates and graduates, with client work and training. Deloitte has an office in Bahrain Bay.

employers.name: Batelco
employers.why: A long-established graduate scheme that mixes telecom training with real tasks under supervision. Batelco is part of Beyon.

employers.name: EY
employers.why: EY’s early careers board lists a Consulting Graduate Program and an audit graduate opening in Manama, both for recent graduates who are nationals.

employers.name: McKinsey & Company
employers.why: McKinsey has an office in Manama. Its Middle East careers page lists student paths and entry roles such as Business Analyst.

employers.name: Amazon Web Services
employers.why: AWS runs a cloud region in Bahrain. Its early career page lists internships for students and jobs for recent graduates.

employers.name: Zain Bahrain
employers.why: A summer internship for university students in teams such as marketing, customer experience, network operations and digital innovation.

employers.name: Al Salam Bank
employers.why: A long-running summer programme: an induction week, then on-the-job placements across the bank’s departments.

employers.name: Kuwait Finance House Bahrain
employers.why: Hands-on training across a wide range of the bank’s departments, with an induction and a mentor.

employers.name: Bahrain Islamic Bank
employers.why: Two months of training across the bank’s departments for university students, working on real projects with experienced staff.

employers.name: Bank ABC
employers.why: An international bank headquartered in Bahrain. Its careers page links to its current vacancies.

employers.name: BBK
employers.why: One of Bahrain’s retail banks. Its careers page takes general applications through a single form.

employers.name: Alba
employers.why: On-the-job training places university students in operational and support functions at Bahrain’s aluminium smelter.

employers.name: Gulf Air
employers.why: A two-month summer internship for university students, run with Bahrain Airport Company and counted towards graduation. 135 students took part in 2026.

employers.name: Information & eGovernment Authority
employers.why: A paid year of on-the-job training in the government’s digital teams for Bahraini graduates in IT, computer science or a related field.

employers.name: Singapore Gulf Bank
employers.why: Three months for Bahraini graduates across banking and finance, digital finance, operations, business development and risk at a digital bank in Bahrain.

employers.name: Bahrain Commercial Facilities Company
employers.why: Bidaya is a two-month summer programme for university students and recent graduates, rotating across the departments of a consumer finance company.

featured.title: CFA Institute Research Challenge 2027
featured.blurb: Teams of students research a listed company, write an equity research report and present it to judges.
featured.note: Teams for the 2026–27 season formed in October. Ask the programme office about joining next season.

certNote: Fees, exam dates and entry rules change, so check each official page before you plan around one. Bahraini job seekers can get some of these paid for by Tamkeen’s Tamakkan programme: CFA, FRM and AWS Cloud Practitioner are on its approved list.

certs.name: CFA Program, Level I
certs.goodFor: Investment, research and finance roles. Three exam levels, and the charter also asks for work experience, so an early start helps.
certs.effortNote: Months of steady study for each level.

certs.name: FRM (Financial Risk Manager)
certs.goodFor: Risk roles in banks, funds and regulators. Two exam parts, and the certification also asks for work experience.
certs.effortNote: Months of study for each part.

certs.name: Power BI Data Analyst (PL-300)
certs.goodFor: Analysts who build reports and dashboards. One exam on preparing, modelling and visualising data in Power BI.
certs.effortNote: A few weeks of regular practice.

certs.name: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
certs.goodFor: A foundation-level exam on cloud basics. A common first step towards data science or machine learning engineering.
certs.effortNote: A few weeks of part-time study.
certs.coversNote: No module teaches cloud hands-on. IS2184 covers information systems in organisations.

certs.name: Google Data Analytics Certificate
certs.goodFor: A guided first step into data analysis, made for beginners. It covers spreadsheets, SQL, Python and Tableau.
certs.effortNote: A few months part-time, at your own pace.

certs.name: Tableau certification
certs.goodFor: Dashboard-focused analyst and BI roles. Desktop Foundations is the entry exam and Data Analyst is the next level.
certs.effortNote: A few weeks of regular practice.

certs.name: Bloomberg Market Concepts (BMC)
certs.goodFor: Treasury, markets and investment roles. A self-paced online course that introduces the financial markets through the Bloomberg Terminal.
certs.effortNote: Self-paced, so it fits around lectures.

certs.name: SQL practice
certs.goodFor: Almost every data role on this page, and the quickest win. Start with SELECT, WHERE and GROUP BY, then joins and window functions.
certs.effortNote: Little and often over a few weeks.

certs.name: IBM Data Science Professional Certificate
certs.goodFor: Python, SQL, Jupyter notebooks, data analysis and a first look at machine learning.
certs.effortNote: Self-paced online, a few months part-time.

certs.name: HarvardX Professional Certificate in Data Science
certs.goodFor: Data science in R: probability, inference, regression and machine learning, taught through real case studies.
certs.effortNote: Nine courses, self-paced over several months.

certs.name: MITx MicroMasters in Statistics and Data Science
certs.goodFor: Graduate-level probability, statistics, machine learning and data analysis. Demanding, and it can count towards a master’s.
certs.effortNote: Several graduate-level courses, over a year or more.

certs.name: Google AI Essentials
certs.goodFor: Using generative AI tools well at work: writing prompts, checking what they produce and using them responsibly.
certs.effortNote: A few weeks, self-paced.

certs.name: Machine Learning Specialization
certs.goodFor: Supervised learning (linear and logistic regression, neural networks) and unsupervised learning (clustering, dimensionality reduction).
certs.effortNote: Self-paced online, a few months part-time.

certs.name: Deep Learning Specialization
certs.goodFor: Neural networks in depth: convolutional and recurrent networks, transformers and how to train them well.
certs.effortNote: Self-paced online, a few months part-time.

certs.name: Natural Language Processing Specialization
certs.goodFor: Working with text: sentiment analysis, translation, attention and transformer models.
certs.effortNote: Self-paced online, a few months part-time.

certs.name: Machine Learning in Production
certs.goodFor: Taking a model from a notebook to real use: planning the project, watching the data and keeping the model working.
certs.effortNote: A few weeks, self-paced.

certs.name: Associate AI Engineer for Data Scientists
certs.goodFor: Training, evaluating and fine-tuning modern AI models, including open-source large language models.
certs.effortNote: Self-paced online, a few months part-time.

certs.name: AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty
certs.goodFor: Building, training, tuning and deploying machine learning models on AWS, with SageMaker.
certs.effortNote: One exam, after weeks of study and hands-on practice.

certs.name: Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer
certs.goodFor: Designing data processing systems on Google Cloud: pipelines, storage, security and running machine learning models.
certs.effortNote: One exam, after weeks of study and hands-on practice.

certs.name: Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100)
certs.goodFor: Running machine learning work on Azure with an Azure Machine Learning workspace.
certs.effortNote: One exam, after weeks of study and hands-on practice.

certs.name: Databricks Certified Associate Developer for Apache Spark
certs.goodFor: Processing big data with Apache Spark DataFrames across a cluster.
certs.effortNote: One exam, after weeks of study and hands-on practice.

certs.name: Cloudera Data Platform Generalist Certification
certs.goodFor: Managing, querying and analysing structured and unstructured data on an enterprise big data platform.
certs.effortNote: One exam, after weeks of study and hands-on practice.

certs.name: Programming for Data Science with Python Nanodegree
certs.goodFor: Python, SQL, Git and GitHub, and the command line, with projects reviewed by mentors.
certs.effortNote: Self-paced online, a few months part-time.

certs.name: SQL Fundamentals
certs.goodFor: Relational databases, joins, aggregations and subqueries, practised in the browser.
certs.effortNote: A few weeks, self-paced.

certs.name: Google IT Automation with Python Professional Certificate
certs.goodFor: Automating tasks with Python, Git and GitHub, debugging and troubleshooting.
certs.effortNote: Self-paced online, a few months part-time.

certs.name: Mathematics for Machine Learning and Data Science Specialization
certs.goodFor: The linear algebra, calculus, probability and statistics behind machine learning, with code.
certs.effortNote: Self-paced online, a few months part-time.

certs.name: A/B Testing
certs.goodFor: Designing online experiments, choosing metrics and testing whether a change really worked.
certs.effortNote: A few weeks, self-paced.

certs.name: Financial Engineering and Risk Management Specialization
certs.goodFor: Pricing derivatives, building portfolios and managing risk with quantitative models.
certs.effortNote: Self-paced online, a few months part-time.

certs.name: DASCA Senior Data Scientist (SDS)
certs.goodFor: A vendor-neutral credential for experienced data scientists: advanced analytics, managing models and data architecture.
certs.effortNote: An exam that asks for work experience first: one to plan for later.

certs.name: INFORMS Certified Analytics Professional (CAP)
certs.goodFor: Running an analytics project end to end: framing the business problem, choosing the method and putting the result to use.
certs.effortNote: An exam that asks for work experience first: one to plan for later.

certs.name: SAS Certified Specialist: Base Programming Using SAS 9.4
certs.goodFor: Programming in SAS: reading and changing data and making summary reports, as many banks and insurers still do.
certs.effortNote: One exam, after weeks of study and hands-on practice.

certs.name: IIBA Certification in Business Data Analytics (CBDA)
certs.goodFor: Linking data analysis to business decisions: framing the question, sourcing the data and explaining the results.
certs.effortNote: One exam, after weeks of study and hands-on practice.

certs.name: Agile with Jira: Plan and Track Sprint Work
certs.goodFor: Agile and Scrum in practice: backlogs, sprints and tracking a team’s work in Jira.
certs.effortNote: A few weeks, self-paced.

certs.name: Health Informatics Specialization
certs.goodFor: How health data is recorded and shared, from electronic health records to data standards and privacy rules.
certs.effortNote: Self-paced online, a few months part-time.

certs.name: AI for Medicine Specialization
certs.goodFor: Diagnosing from X-rays and MRI scans, predicting patient survival and estimating treatment effects from trials.
certs.effortNote: Self-paced online, a few months part-time.

certs.name: AI in Healthcare Specialization
certs.goodFor: Clinical data, health records and medical images, and how to use machine learning safely in hospitals.
certs.effortNote: Self-paced online, a few months part-time.

certs.name: Data Science in Stratified Healthcare and Precision Medicine
certs.goodFor: Genomic and biomedical data, clinical text and linking records for personalised medicine.
certs.effortNote: A few weeks, self-paced.

certs.name: Data Science for Healthcare Specialization
certs.goodFor: Healthcare data standards (HL7, FHIR, ICD-10), keeping patients anonymous, and models that predict disease risk.
certs.effortNote: Self-paced online, a few months part-time.

certs.name: AI for Healthcare Nanodegree
certs.goodFor: Deep learning on medical images, data from wearable sensors and modelling clinical trials.
certs.effortNote: Self-paced online, a few months part-time.

certs.name: Data Engineering Professional Certificate
certs.goodFor: Building data pipelines, warehouses and streaming systems on AWS.
certs.effortNote: Self-paced online, a few months part-time.

certs.name: Machine Learning for Engineering and Science Applications
certs.goodFor: Machine learning and deep learning applied to physical systems and engineering design.
certs.effortNote: Self-paced online, a few months part-time.

certs.name: IBM Data Engineering Professional Certificate
certs.goodFor: Relational and NoSQL databases, Hadoop and Spark, and automating pipelines with Apache Airflow.
certs.effortNote: Self-paced online, a few months part-time.

certs.name: Data Engineering Zoomcamp
certs.goodFor: A free, hands-on programme: Docker, Terraform, Google Cloud, BigQuery, dbt, Kafka and Spark.
certs.effortNote: Free. Self-paced, or with the yearly group.

certs.name: Snowflake Data Engineering Professional Certificate
certs.goodFor: Data pipelines and transformations in a cloud data warehouse, with testing and automated releases.
certs.effortNote: Self-paced online, a few months part-time.

certs.name: Sports Performance Analytics Specialization
certs.goodFor: Modelling player and team performance in Python, testing “Moneyball” ideas and predicting results across several sports.
certs.effortNote: Self-paced online, a few months part-time.

certs.name: Sports Analytics
certs.goodFor: Football, basketball and cricket data with statistics and machine learning, and explaining the results to coaches.
certs.effortNote: A few weeks, self-paced.

certs.name: Foundations of Sports Analytics
certs.goodFor: Cleaning sports data, testing hypotheses and charting athletes’ numbers in Python.
certs.effortNote: A few weeks, self-paced.

certs.name: Wearable Technologies and Sports Analytics
certs.goodFor: Data from fitness trackers, used to plan training load and recovery and to prevent injuries.
certs.effortNote: A few weeks, self-paced.

certs.name: Introduction to Machine Learning in Sports Analytics
certs.goodFor: Classification and logistic regression to judge game strategy and players’ efficiency.
certs.effortNote: A few weeks, self-paced.

roles.label: Data analyst
roles.title: Data analyst
roles.about: Turns messy business data into answers. Pulls it with SQL, cleans it, summarises it and explains what it means to the people who decide.
roles.ask: What should I learn first to become a data analyst?

roles.label: Data scientist
roles.title: Data scientist
roles.about: Builds models that predict or classify, then tests whether they hold up. Part statistician, part programmer, and has to explain the result in plain words.
roles.ask: What should I learn first to become a data scientist?

roles.label: Business analyst
roles.title: Business analyst
roles.about: Works out what a team needs, maps how the process runs today and checks the numbers before a decision is made. Sits between the business and the technical team.
roles.ask: What does a business analyst actually do day to day?

roles.label: BI developer
roles.title: BI developer
roles.about: Builds and looks after the dashboards and data models the rest of the company reads every morning, and fixes the numbers when they do not match.
roles.ask: How do I get started as a BI developer?

roles.label: Risk analyst
roles.title: Risk analyst
roles.about: Measures how likely a loss is and how large it could be, then checks it stays inside the limits. Found in banks, insurers and regulators.
roles.ask: How do I get into risk analysis after DSBA?

roles.label: Financial analyst
roles.title: Financial / investment analyst
roles.about: Reads company accounts, values companies and assets, builds financial models and writes up a recommendation.
roles.ask: How do I get into financial or investment analysis?

presenting.text: Enter the CFA Institute Research Challenge next season and present to a panel.

roles.label: ML engineer
roles.title: Machine learning engineer
roles.about: Takes a model from a notebook to something that runs reliably: data pipelines, training, deployment and monitoring.
roles.ask: What do I need to become a machine learning engineer?

roles.label: Product analyst
roles.title: Product analyst
roles.about: Studies how people use a product, runs experiments and tells the product team what to build or fix next.
roles.ask: How do I get into product analytics?

roles.label: Consultant
roles.title: Consultant
roles.about: Joins a team for a few months to solve one problem for a client: analyses the situation, structures the answer and presents it.
roles.ask: How do I prepare for consulting applications?

taught.what: The SQL course, then Block 3: SQLite from R and Python.
Full R and Python courses, then data structures and control flow.
Block 6 is data wrangling in R and Python; Block 2 covers file formats.
Block 1 introduces Git, and there is a full Git course in the lessons.
Block 5 on object-oriented Python, Block 10 on software development.
The Excel course, then workbooks on decision trees, forecasting and simulation.
Blocks 7 to 8 cover data visualisation in code, plus web data and APIs.
A Tableau course is recommended in the lessons.

bi.name: Dashboards in Power BI or Tableau

taught.what: Only an intro: ST2187 recommends a Tableau course in its lessons.

bi.gapNote: Only an intro: ST2187 recommends a Tableau course in its lessons.

close.text: Do the ST2187 Tableau lessons, then rebuild a dashboard in Power BI.

bi-modelling.name: Data models and measures for BI
bi-modelling.gapNote: Data models for BI tools are not a module topic.

close.text: PL-300 covers data models and DAX measures: use it as a study plan.

cloud.name: Cloud basics
cloud.gapNote: Cloud platforms are not taught hands-on in the modules.

close.text: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner is the usual first step.

deployment.name: Putting a model into use

taught.what: Block 10 on software development is the nearest thing.

deployment.gapNote: Block 10 on software development is the nearest thing.

close.text: Read ST2195 Block 10, then put one model in a script on GitHub.

taught.what: Point estimation and hypothesis testing in depth.
Estimation, confidence intervals, hypothesis tests and ANOVA.
Confidence intervals and hypothesis tests on business data.
Probability spaces, random variables and distributions in depth.
Probability, random variables and the common distributions.
OLS, inference, heteroskedasticity and instrumental variables.
Simple and multiple regression on business data.
Linear regression is the last chapter.
Block 13 is time series analysis and forecasting.
A time series chapter in the econometrics course.
Supervised and unsupervised methods, and how models are trained and evaluated.
Block 9 introduces machine learning frameworks.
Decision trees, optimisation models and Monte Carlo simulation.
Differentiation, optimisation, matrices and linear equations.
More advanced tools for economic analysis and optimisation.
Sampling and hypothesis testing, the maths behind an A/B test.
Statistical techniques for survey and consumer data.
Segmentation through to the marketing mix.
Strategy, international markets, operations, people and digital management.
Markets, firms, labour, money and banking, inflation and exchange rates.
Consumers, firms, market structures and welfare in depth.
Designing, implementing and managing information systems in organisations.
One chapter on global information systems management.

project.name: Project management

taught.what: International project management is one chapter.

project.gapNote: International project management is one chapter.

close.text: Watch the MN1178 project lessons, then plan a small project.

taught.what: How financial assets are valued and how risk and return relate.
Money, banking and interest rates in the macro chapters.

accounting.name: Financial statements and accounting
accounting.gapNote: Accounting is not a module topic.

close.text: Learn to read accounts: CFA Level I covers financial statements.

credit-risk.name: Credit and market risk

taught.what: Risk and return is one part of asset pricing.

credit-risk.gapNote: Risk and return is one part of asset pricing, nothing more.

close.text: The FRM covers market and credit risk in depth across its two parts.

presenting.name: Presenting your findings
presenting.gapNote: A skill you build by doing it, not a module topic.

close.text: Present one project to a study group, then ask for feedback.

structuring.name: Structuring a business problem
structuring.gapNote: Case-style problem solving is not a module topic.

close.text: Practise cases in a study group: one sets it, the rest structure it.

product-metrics.name: Product metrics
product-metrics.gapNote: Funnels and retention are not module topics.

close.text: Use the SQL notebook, then write funnel and retention queries.

checklist.title: A one-page CV
checklist.hint: Lead with skills and projects, then modules. One page is enough.

checklist.title: A LinkedIn profile
checklist.hint: A clear photo, a headline that names the role you want, and your modules listed.

checklist.title: A GitHub portfolio with two projects
checklist.hint: Each one with a README that says the question, the data and what you found.

checklist.title: SQL practice
checklist.hint: Keep going until joins and GROUP BY feel easy.

checklist.title: One mock interview
checklist.hint: Ask a senior to run one. You learn most from the first.

furtherStudy.title: Thinking about an MSc instead?
furtherStudy.body: Most courses publish a minimum degree class and may ask about your maths and statistics modules. Check the entry rules early, and keep an eye on your projected class. These courses and scholarships take applications for 2027. Chevening scholarships aren’t open to Bahraini citizens.

options.name: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
options.note: The full cost of a Cambridge master’s or PhD, for applicants from outside the UK.

options.name: MBZUAI master’s, Abu Dhabi
options.note: AI master’s degrees, including Statistics and Data Science. Funding may be offered, not promised.

options.name: KAUST MS, Saudi Arabia
options.note: Most admitted students get the KAUST Fellowship: tuition, a stipend and housing.

options.name: Erasmus Mundus: CoDaS
options.note: A two-year master’s in communications engineering and data science across two European countries, with EU scholarships for top applicants. Other Erasmus Mundus courses set their own dates.

options.name: HBKU MSc Data Science and Engineering, Qatar
options.note: For graduates in computer science, engineering, maths or a related field, with a GPA of 3.0 or more.

options.name: AlMabarrah AlKhalifia Foundation postgraduate scholarship
options.note: For outstanding Bahrainis aged 23 and over, towards a master’s or PhD at a leading international university.

yearHints.1: Counting Year 1 modules only. Programming starts in Year 2, so a head start on SQL and Git pays off.
yearHints.2: Counting modules up to Year 2. A good year to start a portfolio and look for a first internship.
yearHints.3: Counting every module through Year 3. Graduate applications and MSc courses come first.
